parcel_on_chain.description: Cache of ParcelNFT data minted on the OGCR chain (chain id 2025). One record per parcel_id, populated by OGCR-chain-cache reading the chain. Does not mutate the source `parcel` entity.

parcel_id.description: Links to the `parcel` dynamic entity. The on-chain ParcelNFT is keyed by this id.

token_id.description: ParcelNFT token id minted for this parcel.

parcel_uri.description: parcel_uri stored on-chain: link back to the OBP parcel entity.

parcel_hash.description: parcel_hash stored on-chain: keccak256 of the raw parcel entity body.

owner_address.description: Current owner of the NFT (operator OGCR wallet address).

token_uri.description: tokenURI of the NFT (ERC721 metadata data-URI).

contract_address.description: ParcelNFT contract address the token was read from.

tx_hash.description: Mint transaction hash (from the ParcelMinted event).

block_number.description: Block number the mint was included in.
